$description: Timeline (platform/components/Timeline, library wave 8, lane C): its component tokens. The markers and the line are neutral roles: they show order, not state.

timeline-item-gap.$description: Timeline: the space between one event and the next (vertical).

timeline-column-gap.$description: Timeline: the space between the marker and the content (and between events, horizontal).

timeline-marker-size.$description: Timeline: the marker's box, and the height of the content's first line, so the two share a middle.

timeline-dot-size.$description: Timeline: the small circle of an event without an icon.

timeline-icon-marker-background.$description: Timeline: the circle behind an event's icon (with icons).

timeline-icon-marker-border-width.$description: Timeline: the icon circle's border width.

timeline-icon-size.$description: Timeline: an event's icon size (16px in the 24px circle).

timeline-line-color.$description: Timeline: the line between the markers.

timeline-content-row-gap.$description: Timeline: the space between the time, the title, the description and the content.

timeline-heading-gap.$description: Timeline: the space between the title and its badge.

timeline-time-font-family.$description: Timeline: the date or time is a technical value (Reddit Mono).

timeline-time-font-size.$description: Timeline: the date or time's size.

timeline-description-text.$description: Timeline: the line or two about the event.

timeline-horizontal-item-width.$description: Timeline: an event's width in a horizontal timeline.

timeline-focus-outline-color.$description: Timeline: the focus ring of a horizontal timeline (a scrolling region, one Tab stop).

timeline-grouped-group-gap.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the space between two year groups.

timeline-grouped-heading-font-size.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the year heading size (the title role).

timeline-grouped-heading-font-weight.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the year heading weight.

timeline-grouped-heading-rule-width.$deprecated: The line under a year heading is no longer drawn (ADR 0048). It keeps working and is removed in 2.0.0.
timeline-grouped-heading-rule-width.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the soft line under the year heading: its length.

timeline-grouped-heading-rule-height.$deprecated: The line under a year heading is no longer drawn (ADR 0048). It keeps working and is removed in 2.0.0.
timeline-grouped-heading-rule-height.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the soft line under the year heading: its thickness.

timeline-grouped-heading-rule-color.$deprecated: The line under a year heading is no longer drawn (ADR 0048). It keeps working and is removed in 2.0.0.
timeline-grouped-heading-rule-color.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the soft line under the year heading.

timeline-grouped-heading-rule-radius.$deprecated: The line under a year heading is no longer drawn (ADR 0048). It keeps working and is removed in 2.0.0.
timeline-grouped-heading-rule-radius.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the soft line under the year heading: its corners.

timeline-grouped-heading-rule-gap.$deprecated: The line under a year heading is no longer drawn (ADR 0048). It keeps working and is removed in 2.0.0.
timeline-grouped-heading-rule-gap.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the space between the year heading and its line.

timeline-grouped-heading-gap.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the space between the year heading block and the first event.

timeline-grouped-watermark-font-size.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the watermark year size.

timeline-grouped-watermark-font-weight.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the watermark year weight.

timeline-grouped-watermark-color.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the watermark year ink (decorative).

timeline-grouped-watermark-gap.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the space between the watermark and its event.

timeline-grouped-event-gap.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the space between two events.

timeline-grouped-event-padding-block.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): an event container: padding above and below.

timeline-grouped-event-padding-inline.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): an event container: padding at the sides.

timeline-grouped-event-radius.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): an event container: corners.

timeline-grouped-event-border-width.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): an event container: border.

timeline-grouped-event-column-gap.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): an event container: the gap between its date, body and tag.

timeline-grouped-event-neutral-backgroun.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): an event with no category: its fill.

timeline-grouped-event-neutral-border.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): an event with no category: its border.

timeline-grouped-event-neutral-text.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): an event with no category: its title.

timeline-grouped-event-description-text.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): an event: its description.

timeline-grouped-event-description-font-.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): an event: its description size.

timeline-grouped-event-title-font-size.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): an event: its title size (the heading role).

timeline-grouped-event-title-font-weight.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): an event: its title weight.

timeline-grouped-tint-amount.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): how much of the category text color tints an event (none in light, a little in dark).

timeline-grouped-tint-border-amount.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): how much of the category text color goes in an event border (none in light, more in dark).

timeline-grouped-date-size.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the calendar date tile: width and height.

timeline-grouped-date-radius.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the calendar date tile: corners.

timeline-grouped-date-background.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the calendar date tile: its page.

timeline-grouped-date-border-color.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the calendar date tile: its border.

timeline-grouped-date-band-size.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the calendar date tile: the top band height.

timeline-grouped-date-band-upcoming.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the calendar date tile of an upcoming event: the grey band.

timeline-grouped-date-ring-width.$deprecated: The date tile has no binder rings any more (ADR 0048). It keeps working and is removed in 2.0.0.
timeline-grouped-date-ring-width.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the calendar date tile: a binder ring, its width.

timeline-grouped-date-ring-height.$deprecated: The date tile has no binder rings any more (ADR 0048). It keeps working and is removed in 2.0.0.
timeline-grouped-date-ring-height.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the calendar date tile: a binder ring, its height.

timeline-grouped-date-ring-radius.$deprecated: The date tile has no binder rings any more (ADR 0048). It keeps working and is removed in 2.0.0.
timeline-grouped-date-ring-radius.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the calendar date tile: a binder ring, its corners.

timeline-grouped-date-month-font-size.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the calendar date tile: the month size.

timeline-grouped-date-month-font-weight.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the calendar date tile: the month weight.

timeline-grouped-date-month-text.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the calendar date tile: the month.

timeline-grouped-date-day-font-size.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the calendar date tile: the day size.

timeline-grouped-date-day-font-weight.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the calendar date tile: the day weight.

timeline-grouped-date-day-text.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the calendar date tile: the day.

timeline-grouped-date-pending-text.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the calendar date tile of an event with no date: the word Pending.

timeline-grouped-date-pending-font-size.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the calendar date tile: the word Pending, size.

timeline-grouped-date-pending-font-weigh.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the calendar date tile: the word Pending, weight.

timeline-grouped-tag-radius.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the category tag at the end of an event: corners.

timeline-grouped-tag-background.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the category tag: its fill.

timeline-grouped-tag-font-size.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the category tag: size.

timeline-grouped-tag-font-weight.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the category tag: weight.

timeline-grouped-tag-padding-block.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the category tag: padding above and below.

timeline-grouped-tag-padding-inline.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the category tag: padding at the sides.

timeline-grouped-legend-gap.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the legend: the gap between its buttons.

timeline-grouped-legend-offset.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): the total space between the legend and the first year heading (the group gap is taken off it, as the legend is in the gapped column).

timeline-grouped-legend-swatch-size.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): a legend swatch: width and height.

timeline-grouped-legend-swatch-gap.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): a legend swatch: the space before its label (the icon gap of a Button).

timeline-grouped-legend-swatch-radius.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): a legend swatch: corners.

timeline-grouped-legend-swatch-border-wi.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): a legend swatch (hollow when the category is hidden): its border.

timeline-grouped-legend-text.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): a legend button that is on.

timeline-grouped-legend-text-off.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0036): a legend button that is off.

timeline-grouped-date-month-upcoming-tex.$description: Timeline, grouped (ADR 0048): the calendar date tile: the month on the grey band of an upcoming or uncategorized event.

timeline-grouped-compact-max-inline-size.$description: Timeline, compact grouped (ADR 0048): the readable maximum inline size.

timeline-grouped-compact-group-gap.$description: Timeline, compact grouped (ADR 0048): the space between the year groups.

timeline-grouped-compact-heading-gap.$description: Timeline, compact grouped (ADR 0048): the space between a year heading and its first event.

timeline-grouped-compact-heading-font-si.$description: Timeline, compact grouped (ADR 0048): the year heading size.

timeline-grouped-compact-event-gap.$description: Timeline, compact grouped (ADR 0048): the space between events.

timeline-grouped-compact-event-padding-b.$description: Timeline, compact grouped (ADR 0048): an event box, block padding (equal to the inline padding).

timeline-grouped-compact-event-padding-i.$description: Timeline, compact grouped (ADR 0048): an event box, inline padding (equal to the block padding).

timeline-grouped-compact-body-gap.$description: Timeline, compact grouped (ADR 0048): the space between the title and the description on the one line.
